selection: First four sessions of the already frozen 12-question REST development cohort, unchanged question/vector rows. REST outcomes observed before this client-path check; not held-out or randomized treatment evidence.

sessions.question: What validation had the proposed single-source optical computing design actually provided in the available preprint?
Why can accumulating tool results make selective reading of an agent's existing context useful even when retrieval is already available?
In the streaming image-classification experiment with changing classes, how did the learned learning rates evolve in early layers compared with the final layer?
In the financial forecasting review, how does an expanding training set differ from a rolling training window?

transport: Fresh independent Codex subagent launches fixed local REPL/API pair in its own namespace, calls setup once, then only ordinary MCP tools/call search and fetch using rpc helper. No advanced REST, labels, files, other network, or agents. First exact query uses its saved vector.
accounting: Entire raw MCP response bodies including any duplicated text/structured fields; not an assumption that every MCP client displays these bytes. Setup excluded; terminal error reserve37. Repeated text counts. Raw-wire budget results cannot be generalized to connector-specific rendered context.
grading: Same supported-answer and visible-evidence rubric as frozen REST protocol; fixed answers before grading, equivalent evidence accepted. No gold-directed navigation.
